messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime capacity slate — signoff request for two ICs + staff engineer contingency

Hi Laura / Jonas / Dev,

Quick ask: the runtime team needs approval to open two senior SWE roles (runtime infra) and one staff-level contingency slot for Q3 to cover anticipated latency work and a cross-team compiler project. Summary: 

- Role 1: Senior SWE, runtime inference (x2) — comp band: L5 (USD 190–230k base), target offer midpoint we propose: USD 210k base + 20% target bonus + equity band C.
- Role 2: Staff SWE (contingency) — comp band: L6 (USD 260–320k base), will only be posted/filled if we clear both ICs and show sustained 30% capacity increase needs.

Rationale: 1) We are projecting sustained 18% higher qps for low-latency customers after new batching changes landed. 2) There are two upcoming enterprise pilots (one in fintech, one in health) that require dedicated runtime throughput ownership. 3) We have a prioritized roadmap item to reduce tail latency by 25% — needs two focused hires.

Headcount ask: 2 FTEs (immediate) + 1 contingency (req approval now so recruiting can prep). Budget impact: ~USD 720k run-rate fully loaded if all filled at midpoint.

Attached: HC sheet with budget delta and proposed JD snippets (hc_request_runtime_may2027.xlsx). I've also attached the offer template we plan to use.

If this looks OK I need a signoff to raise reqs in Greenhouse (RH-1179) and loop in TalentBridge for active search (Helen Park). Proposed deadline for posting: next Tuesday (2027-05-25) so we can interview in early June.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- hc_request_runtime_may2027.xlsx (spreadsheet: budget, org map)
- offer_template_runtime_senior.pdf (PDF: offer language stub)

Sean — thanks for the clear summary. A couple of quick questions before I sign off:

1) Can you confirm the hiring priority order? If we only get one headcount approved now, which role is first to open?
2) Have we re-used any existing open reqs to avoid extra HC? (we have a tight org quota this quarter)
3) For the staff contingency: what's the trigger for converting that from contingency to live posting? Need measurable criteria.

If you can reply with a one-line prioritization and a measurable trigger for the staff slot I can approve the two immediate ICs contingent on budget signoff from finance (I'll ping them).

-Laura
